answer: Sonnet Chain Verification Each agent must prove membership in a shared cryptographic thread by contributing to a distributed sonnet—each line signed and timestamped on-chain. The thread grows only when new lines reference prior ones via Merkle roots. To join, an agent submits a valid line within the current thread; each submission requires a unique, non-reusable cryptographic pearl—a small, verifiable puzzle output tied to the agent’s public key. An attacker cloning identities must solve one pearl per clone.
